title: Effective fpqc descent for quasi-affine scheme morphisms
statement: Let $p:A\to B$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose one-member family is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let $V\to A$ be a quasi-affine morphism [def-nagata-quasi-affine-morphism]: the inverse image of each affine open in $A$ is a quasi-affine scheme, meaning a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme. Let $\phi:V\times_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}A\times_B V$ be an isomorphism over $A\times_B A$ satisfying $\phi_{02}=\phi_{12}\circ\phi_{01}$ on $A\times_B A\times_B A$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pd-descent-datum]. Then this datum is effective: there exist a scheme $V_0\to B$ and an isomorphism $V_0\times_B A\simeq V$ over $A$ inducing $\phi$. No local finite-presentation hypothesis on $V\to A$ is imposed. All schemes are in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 0247, lemma-quasi-affine, one-member fpqc covering specialization; used in Tag 02W8 for each saturated quasi-compact open.

proof.text: For an affine open U of A, the definition of IsQuasiAffineHom makes (V.hom inverse-image U) quasi-affine. The canonical pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict identifies V times_A U with that open subscheme, so it too is quasi-affine. This uses only restriction along the given open immersion, not arbitrary base-change stability.

Let K be any quasi-compact open of V times_A U. Its scheme is compact by isCompact_iff_compactSpace and quasi-affine by Mathlib Scheme.IsQuasiAffine.of_isImmersion applied to K.ι. Its structure map to the affine scheme U is quasi-compact by quasiCompact_of_compactSpace (the target is quasi-separated), hence quasi-affine by the source-library instance for quasi-compact maps from quasi-affine schemes. This verifies exactly the chart condition of lem-a1-ind-quasi-affine-fpqc-effective-descent, including K empty.

Apply the already stated general effective fpqc descent theorem for ind-quasi-affine morphisms, lem-a1-ind-quasi-affine-fpqc-effective-descent, to p, hp, the chart condition from the previous two steps, and D. Its conclusion is precisely D.IsEffective, with the same transport datum and no additional hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0APK, lemma-ind-quasi-affine, specialized to quasi-affine morphisms by the compact-open chart argument; proves the unchanged Tag 0247 conclusion. Shorter route using the overlap already noted in reviewed.note (2026-10-22).
